rows.finding: The three-way automotive teaching classification is positively illustrated in a publisher-hosted sample: radial = ball, needle roller, cylindrical roller; thrust = ball, needle roller; angular = ball, tapered roller. Thus replacing tapered with cylindrical in option 2 is supported within this teaching classification. This is a classification correction, not a claim that tapered rollers cannot carry radial loads or cannot be used in transmissions.

classificationAndApplicationDistinction.finding: NSK generic radial-type branch includes angular-contact ball bearings and tapered roller bearings. This taxonomy is different from the teaching three-way grouping. The generic classification is real and must not be dismissed as a source error.

rows.proposedTechnicalExplanation: In the automotive teaching three-way grouping, radial bearings include ball, needle-roller and cylindrical-roller types; tapered rollers appear in the angular group. Option 2 substitutes tapered for cylindrical. Manufacturer catalogs may instead place tapered and angular-contact bearings under a broader radial category, and tapered bearings are used in real transmissions.
